report_fields.indicator_label: HC01: New clients enrolled in HIV care
report_fields.sqlQuery:
WITH base_pop AS (
  WITH A AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary a
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = a.client_id
  WHERE a.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_datetime <  :endDate
    AND a.hiv_enrollment_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
    AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  ),
  B AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_transfer_in a
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = a.client_id
  WHERE a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date <  :endDate
    AND a.transfer_in_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
    AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT DISTINCT
      A.patient_id
  FROM A
  LEFT JOIN B
      ON B.patient_id = A.patient_id
  WHERE B.patient_id IS NULL
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'HMIS_106A'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id AS age_group_id,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.patient_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = base_pop.patient_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F','M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
    ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
   AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;
